response_file_sha256: fill with SHA256 of completed response file after freeze and before scorer opens
non_claim: template only; not a completed custody record, not a clean response, not a score sheet, not compact-cue confirmation, and not independent certification
timestamp_order: responder-local: responder_stage.run_started_at <= responder_stage.run_completed_at = response.response_artifact.finalized_at; custodian-local: custody_kit_opened_at <= response_observed_at and every prerequisite observed_at <= custody_record_frozen_at; cross-operator order is exact-artifact hash chaining, not wall-clock comparison
self_hash_boundary: The custodian verifies the responder-observed bundle digest from this post-freeze template; no expected bundle digest is visible inside the responder bundle before response.
preanswer_material_boundary: Clean evidence is admissible only when pre_response_materials_given is exactly the responder bundle and no custody/scorer/score-sheet/manifest/submission material was visible before response.
scorer_material_boundary: The custody helper accepts only a responder-finalize-v1 artifact, reruns the complete shared response validator, records a local observation of the exact response bytes, binds every template-required prerequisite artifact by SHA-256, and freezes custody before scorer material opens.
timestamp_trust_boundary: Responder and custodian timestamps are descriptive local observations. They are ordered only within their producing process; exact response and prerequisite hashes carry causality across operators and machines.
causal_chain_boundary: The completed record must bind the exact response bytes and every required prerequisite artifact. An isolated-arm template requires the all-response lock and postfreeze policy-verification receipt; the conventional template requires no extra prerequisite.
